application_not_found: This application no longer exists or is not accepted. Please reload the page.
change_contract_not_active: This contract is no longer in force. The school now decides change requests.
change_ends_care: The parents give up all care with this. That is a termination. Please record it under “End contract” or reject the request.
change_not_applicable: The school does not allow this change right now. Please talk to the school.
change_not_found: This change request no longer exists. Please reload the page.
contract_input_invalid: Please select at least one and at most 200 entries.
contract_not_draft: The contract has already been sent. It can no longer be discarded.
contract_not_endable: This contract is already terminated or withdrawn, or not concluded yet. Please reload the page.
contract_not_found: This contract does not exist. Please open it from “Contracts”.
contract_not_signable: This contract is already signed or is not waiting for a signature. Please reload the page.
field_invalid: Some details are not valid. Please check your entries.
letterhead_too_long: The sender or footer is too long for the contract. Please shorten it under “Letterhead and templates”.
notice_end_not_open: This contract has no open end date any more. Please reload the page.
notice_template_missing: The provider has no confirmation text yet. Please contact the provider.
offering_not_found: This offering no longer exists at the school. Please reload the page.
paper_document_invalid: Please upload the signed contract as a PDF. The file may be at most 10 MB.
recipient_missing: This contract has no e-mail address. Without an address no confirmation can be sent.
school_outside_traeger: This school does not belong to your provider.
selection_invalid: This selection is not possible. Please change your selection.
signature_invalid: The signature is missing or empty. Please sign again.
signing_letterhead_missing: Your signature has not been saved yet. The provider is still missing some details. Please try again later or contact the provider.
signing_link_invalid: This link is no longer valid. It was already used or has expired. You can find the contract in the parent app under “Documents”, or ask the provider for a new link.
special_termination_closed: This contract has no special termination. Please choose the regular termination.
withdrawal_closed: The withdrawal period is over. You can still terminate the contract.
withdrawal_notice_required: Please confirm that you have read the cancellation policy.
import_file_invalid: {object} could not be saved. Please check your entries.
import_file_too_large: {object} could not be saved. Please check your entries.
import_changed: {object} could not be changed. Please check its current status.
letterhead_missing: The sender in the letterhead is missing. Without the provider's name and address, no contract can be sent or handed over on paper. Please add it under “Letterhead and templates”.
child_link_changed: The details have changed since the check. Please check them again.
child_link_not_imported: Only imported contracts can be linked here. This contract belongs to the child of its application.
child_link_refused: The contract cannot be linked to this child record like this. Please check the details again.
child_link_bound: The contract is already bound to the child’s enrollment. The link to the child record can no longer be removed.
enrollment_preview_changed: The contracts or the school have changed since the preview. Reload the preview and check it again.
enrollment_binding_changed: The contract is no longer bound to this enrollment. Reload the page and check the current state.
